scope: Automated ingredient-level nutrition source comparison for 655 g ingredients and four servings. Reference coconut milk is not a specified consumer product; polyol components for these four ingredients have not been independently verified. Public macro values are withheld; this is not a measured dessert yield or glycaemic response.
withholdingReason: Precise polyol source components and product-specific canned coconut milk nutritional data are unverified. An estimated carbohydrate subtotal must not be published as complete macros or GK.
